event.name: Binance Blockchain Week 2026
event.theme_description: Finance is making an evolutionary leap and this year's Binance Blockchain Week theme, EVOLVE , is built around it. TradFi and blockchain are converging, and the markets that once ran on business hours are becoming global, open and always-on. At the same time, AI is transforming how freely people move, manage and grow their money carrying us toward a world where financial freedom is effortless and self-directed. Empowerment for millions. The definition of finance is being rewritten in real time. EVOLVE is our recognition that we're not just watching that happen - we’re part of the evolution.
event.description: This November, Binance Blockchain Week touches down in Bangkok for an exclusive Asia Edition and it's set to be one of the biggest moments in the crypto calendar. Expect headline panels, unfiltered talks, serious networking and a few surprises we're not ready to spoil just yet. Founders, innovators, policy makers and community members all under one roof, helping drive the industry forward.  This is where it all comes together.   It's happening - and it's happening fast - so grab your tickets and we'll see you at the front!    Check out our 2025 event in Dubai .

speakers.name: Yi He
speakers.title: Co-CEO and Co-Founder
speakers.biography: Binance Co-CEO and Co-Founder Yi He oversees global operations and user experience and leads global business and product strategy, establishing the company’s vision and strategic priorities.

speakers.name: Richard Teng
speakers.title: Co-CEO
speakers.biography: Binance Co-CEO Richard Teng is a veteran executive and former regulator in the financial services industry, drawing on more than three decades of experience to advance digital asset adoption and sustainable business growth, including global market expansion.

speakers.name: CZ
speakers.title: Entrepreneur & Founder
speakers.biography: Changpeng Zhao, known as CZ, is an entrepreneur, investor and philanthropist, best known for founding Binance and helping shape the global cryptocurrency and digital asset industry.

speakers.name: Dan Maley
speakers.title: APAC Head of Digital Assets
speakers.biography: Dan Maley, Director is APAC Head of Digital Assets, responsible for leading BlackRock’s digital assets strategy and commercial agenda across Asia Pacific, driving implementation of products focused on cryptoassets, digital currencies and tokenized assets. Over the last 14 years at BlackRock, Mr. Maley has built deep expertise across clients, markets, product strategy, and innovation. Including the successful the development of localized tokenized money market fund solutions, working with clients, regulators and ecosystem partners to bring new digital asset capabilities to market. Mr. Maley is a board member for Love 21 Foundation, a charity empowering the Down syndrome and autistic community in Hong Kong. Mr. Maley earned a BS degree in Accounting from Fairfield University in 2011.

speakers.name: Roger Bayston
speakers.title: Head of Digital Assets Ecosystem Development
speakers.biography: Roger Bayston leads digital asset efforts at Franklin Templeton. His team is responsible for creating new generations of products and services focused on the rapidly expanding opportunities within digital assets and their supporting infrastructure. This includes services dedicated to mature cryptocurrency powered blockchain networks and newer incubator projects committed to companies in the distributed ledger space. Roger's team also builds infrastructure that bridges traditional financial market products and services into the digital asset ecosystem.Roger has over 36 years of experience in the financial services industry. He is a member of the firm's Management Committee and currently serves on the Board for Fiduciary Trust Company, a wealth management subsidiary of Franklin Templeton. Roger joined Franklin Templeton in 1991 as a research analyst and served as a portfolio manager and business leader for Franklin Templeton Fixed Income for many years.Roger holds a bachelor of science from University of Virginia, and an MBA from University of California at Los Angeles. Prior to getting his MBAhe was previously with Bankers Trust Company. He is a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) charterholder.

speakers.name: Eowyn Chen
speakers.title: Interim Chief Marketing Officer
speakers.biography: Eowyn Chen is the Interim Chief Marketing Officer at Binance, where she leads global marketing and brand strategy to drive user growth, drawing on her previous experience scaling Trust Wallet's business and expanding its global user base as CEO.

speakers.name: Catherine Chen
speakers.title: Head of VIP & Institutional
speakers.biography: Catherine Chen is Head of VIP & Institutional at Binance, overseeing global coverage of its institutional and high-value clients, drawing on over 15 years of traditional finance experience at leading bulge-brackets institutions, including Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan, with deep expertise in structured derivatives and solutions.

speakers.name: Ella Zhang
speakers.title: Managing Partner & Head of YZi Labs
speakers.biography: Ella Zhang has spent her career shaping frontier technologies and digital assets. As the founding head of Binance Labs and now co-builder of YZi Labs with CZ, she has been at the center of Web3’s most defining shifts.Trained at Kleiner Perkins, Google, Stanford GSB, and twice as a founder herself, Ella combines the discipline of value investing with the conviction to back bold ideas for the long term. Her journey spans co-founding AI startups in supply chain and customer service, leading global investment platforms, and supporting founders who prove their vision through execution.Trained at Kleiner Perkins, Google and Stanford GSB, and twice a founder herself, Ella combines the discipline of value investing with the conviction to back bold ideas for the long term. Her career spans co-founding AI startups in supply chain and customer service, leading global investment platforms, and supporting founders who prove their vision through execution.YZi Labs' portfolio covers more than 300 projects across 25+ countries, including Trust Wallet, CoinMarketCap, Polygon, Injective and Ethena. More than 65 portfolio companies have come through its incubation programs, including EASY Residency.39

speakers.name: Alex Svanevik
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.biography: Alex Svanevik is the co-founder and CEO of Nansen.ai. He has a background in artificial intelligence, with over 10 years of experience as a data scientist and management consultant before co-founding Nansen in 2019. Additionally, Alex is one of the initial DAO members of Lido Finance and PleasrDAO.

speakers.name: Anastasia Melachrinos
speakers.title: Head of Research
speakers.biography: Anastasia Melachrinos is the Head of Growth and Research at Kaiko, a leading data services provider bridging the gap between capital markets and decentralized finance. In her current role, she oversees revenue growth, marketing, research, and communications. Previously, as a Product Manager, she was instrumental in building the foundation of Kaiko’s blockchain and decentralized finance data offerings. Outside of Kaiko, she serves as an adjunct lecturer for Master’s students at École Polytechnique and Sorbonne University, where she teaches courses on blockchain technology, decentralized finance, and crypto regulation. She holds a Master’s degree in Finance with a specialization in Data Science from Sorbonne University and has been actively involved in the cryptocurrency space since 2016.

speakers.name: Arthur Hayes
speakers.title: CIO
speakers.biography: Arthur Hayes is the CIO of Maelstrom, CEO of Flop Labs, and the co-founder of BitMEX. Prior to entering the crypto industry, he worked as a trader in the capital markets divisions of Deutsche Bank and Citibank. Arthur holds a Bachelors of Economics from the Wharton School of Business. He has appeared on major business news networks including Bloomberg and CNBC. He is active on X (@cryptohayes) and releases a monthly newsletter (Crypto Trader Digest) read by thousands of investors globally.

speakers.name: Athena Y
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.biography: Athena is CEO of United Stables, leading the team behind $U — a BNB Chain-native stablecoin that scaled from zero to $1 billion in circulation within three months of launch.A crypto native with deep expertise across digital assets, payments, and institutional finance, Athena previously served as Global Head of Fiat Business Development at Binance and CEO of its institutional custody arm, where she gained hands-on mastery of stablecoin mechanics, regulated financial products, and cross-border payment rails.Before crypto, Athena spent several years in global development finance, working across more than ten African countries. She served as an advisor to the Prime Minister of Senegal on national investment promotion policy, and led impact investments deploying fintech solutions across the continent. She also built and ran the world’s largest blockchain-based philanthropic platform, channeling tens of millions of dollars in charitable capital to African beneficiaries through fully on-chain, transparent distribution — a formative experience that grounds her conviction in digital currency’s power to democratize financial access in emerging markets.A World Economic Forum Global Shaper and graduate of the London School of Economics and Renmin University of China, Athena bridges frontier technology with real-world economic impact. She is building toward a fluid future where value flows seamlessly between humans, institutions, and AI agents.396:["pr

speakers.name: Gizzat Baitursynov
speakers.title: Vice Minister
speakers.company: Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan
speakers.biography: Gizzat Baitursynov is the Vice Minister of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan.With his participation, large-scale projects in artificial intelligence and advanced technologies have been implemented, including the development of national language models, the establishment of the Alem.cloud supercomputing cluster, the launch of the Alem.ai International Artificial Intelligence Center, and the creation of the Council for the Development of Artificial Intelligence under the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan.A separate focus of his work is the advancement of breakthrough technologies, digital assets, the crypto industry, robotics, autonomous transport, drones, high-performance computing, and modern digital infrastructure.

speakers.name: Min Lin
speakers.title: Managing Director, Head of Global Business Development
speakers.biography: Min Lin is the Managing Director, Head of Global Business Development at Ondo Finance, where he oversees institutional partnerships and international growth for on-chain market infrastructure and tokenized financial assets. Min has a background in bridging traditional and decentralized finance. He previously served as Chief Business Officer at Bitget and as a senior executive at Binance, where he held roles as Global Head of Business Development and Head of Latin America. Before making his pivot to Web3, Min was an Executive Director within the Global Markets Division at Goldman Sachs.

speakers.name: Nischint Sanghavi
speakers.title: Head of Digital Currencies - AP
speakers.biography: Nischint is the Head of Digital Currencies in Asia Pacific. He and his team are responsible for overseeing Visa’s digital currency business in AP including creating and growing new revenue streams and partnerships.  Nischint also serves as the subject matter expert on digital currency and web 3.0 engagements supporting client facing teams with key stakeholders such as banks, fintech’s, regulators and blockchain infrastructure companies. He also oversees emerging CBDC and tokenized deposit products and GTM efforts.

speakers.name: Shaun Tan
speakers.title: Head of Crypto and Fintech Growth
speakers.biography: Shaun Tan is Head of Crypto & Fintech Growth at Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC), where he leads ecosystem growth, strategic partnerships and the development of GMC’s crypto and fintech sector. At GMC, he focuses on attracting leading global companies, building high-impact partnerships and supporting the development of a globally competitive financial and digital asset ecosystem in Bhutan.Prior to joining GMC, Shaun spent 10 years at Goldman Sachs and three years at Binance, bringing extensive experience across global financial markets, digital assets and strategic growth.

speakers.name: Yoshi Yokokawa
speakers.title: Co-founder and CEO
speakers.biography: Yoshi Yokokawa is the Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Alpaca, a global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure transforming how financial services are built and accessed. He brings nearly two decades of experience across traditional financial markets and fintech. Before co-founding Alpaca, Yoshi served as Managing Partner at a software development firm focused on big data solutions. Prior to that, he was a Forex trader and Vice President in Structured Finance at Nomura Holdings, and began his career at Lehman Brothers. Yoshi has been recognized as a 2025 Endeavor Entrepreneur and 2026 EY Entrepreneur Of The Year finalist. He is a Y Combinator alum and holds a degree from Keio University in Tokyo.

speakers.name: Yuki Jinguji
speakers.title: Head of Financial Business Development
speakers.biography: Yuki Jinguji is Head of Finance Business Development Division at PayPay Corporation. He has more than 20 years of experience across banking, international business and fintech. Before joining PayPay in 2020, he held leadership roles at MUFG Bank in Japan and China, Rakuten Bank, and Rakuten International Commercial Bank, where he served as Chief Marketing Officer. At PayPay, he has led financial institution relations and financial strategy and now oversees finance business development, building strategic partnerships across the financial ecosystem.
